items.title: Windows Webview2, Keyboard UK Extended, Typing German Umlaut
items.body:
### Description

I am using a keyboard 'United Kingdom Extended' on Windows. This allows me to type German Umlaute (ä, ö, ü) as follows:

<kbd>Alt Gr </kbd>+ <kbd>2</kbd>, then <kbd>A</kbd>, <kbd>O</kbd> or <kbd>U</kbd>

Unfortunately this does not work in the Wails/Webview2. Instead, the 'normal' letters are typed (a, o, u).

### To Reproduce

1. Create the default wails app `wails init -n myproject -t vue` and start it
2. Select the keyboard layout 'United Kingdom Extended'
3. As greet-name (input field) type <kbd>Alt Gr </kbd>+ <kbd>2</kbd> followed by <kbd>U</kbd>  which should type ü 

Result: 
The letter entered is a 'u' instead of 'ü'

### Expected behaviour

<kbd>Alt Gr </kbd>+ <kbd>2</kbd> - <kbd>U</kbd> should type 'ü'
<kbd>Alt Gr </kbd> +<kbd> 2</kbd> - <kbd>O</kbd> should type 'ö'
<kbd>Alt Gr </kbd> +<kbd> 2</kbd> - <kbd>A</kbd> should type 'ä'

### Screenshots

_No response_

### Attempted Fixes

- When I connect a keyboard with a german layout, then it is possible to type umlaute using the specific keys.
- Running the standard example from github.com/jchv/go-webview2, I can enter umlaute with a United Kindom Extended keyboard layout as expected. Therefore I assume the problem is something related to wails.
